name: wcstack-community-hall
description: Seam app: wcstack islands on a page it does not own — a community hall's CMS site with htmx 2 (boosted navigation, a live search, fragments), and a booking widget on a partner inn's Turbo site that runs its own wcstack 4.17.0 (a scoped registry). Inserted markup handed to the binder and released, history caches turned off, one root per swapped body.
